blocks.tamil_translation: narrates, a man asked Rasulullah ﷺ, “O Rasulullah! If a person goes in the path of Allah Ta'ala with the intention of getting some wealth for himself (what reward will he get?)” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “He will not get any reward.” The people found the Prophet's ﷺ answer very heavy. “Ask the Prophet ﷺ again; perhaps you did not make the Prophet ﷺ understand properly,” the people urged him. He asked again, “O Rasulullah! A person goes for jihad with the intention of getting some worldly goods for himself?” To that the Prophet ﷺ said, “He will not get any reward.” The people said to him, “Ask your question again,” and he asked a third time. The third time too Rasulullah ﷺ said, “He will not get any reward.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: وَكَانَ النَّاسُ إِذَا نَزَلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ مَنْزِلاً تَفَرَّقُوا فِي الشِّعَابِ وَاْلاَوْدِيَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ تَفَرُّقَكُمْ فِي هذِهِ الشِّعَابِ وَاْلاَوْدِيَةِ إِنَّمَا ذلِكُمْ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ فَلَمْ يَنْزِلْ بَعْدَ ذلِكَ مَنْزِلاً إِلَّا انْضَمَّ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَي بَعْضٍ حَتَّي يُقَالَ: لَوْ بُسِطَ عَلَيْهِمْ ثَوْبٌ لَعَمَّهُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب ما يؤمر من انضمام العسكر وسعته. رقم:٢٦٢٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Tha'labah Khushani (RA) narrates, “Whenever Rasulullah ﷺ happened to halt somewhere on a journey, he would set up a tent. The Sahabah (RA) would split up and camp in the mountain passes and valleys. “Your splitting up like this and camping in the passes and valleys is an act prompted by Shaytan.” (He wants to separate you from one another) said
